reviews.body:
Lots of test cases now only require 1 signer for Alice - are those test cases still different or are there now many duplicate tests being run?

I'm also noticing a few test cases towards the end of the review where the number of enabled/disabled features should now be different, but it hasn't changed - are those correct?

reviewCommentsList.body: Took a second look at what I did here and I think it was wrong even though it didn't produce an error. I initially removed `featureMultiSignReserve` from those tests because we were removing the feature. However, I think what those tests do is that it takes 2 random features, passes them to the `Env`, and checks if they're enabled. So what we should do here is replace `featureMultiSignReserve` with something else.

reviewCommentsList.author: a1q123456
reviewCommentsList.body: There's 2 features on the list now just as before except that the first feature is replaced with `featureDynamicMPT` which doesn't make too much difference here.

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: You can consider removing `signersCount` and in the appropriate lines below by `BEAST_EXPECT(ownerCount(env, bob) == 2)`.

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: This test seems to be run with the feature enabled, and seems to be different from other tests. Why is this test removed?

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body:
The `ExpandedSignerList` feature can also be retired. Do you want to combine that in this PR, or do it separately? 

@pratikmankawde was originally going to work on retiring `ExpandedSignerList `.

reviewCommentsList.author: a1q123456
reviewCommentsList.body:
Yeah, this test and the one above are just checking what will happen if we attach a big signer list and give the account insufficient money and see what's going to happen. It makes sense to do it before the fix but I don't think it makes any difference with the feature enabled. 
But I can add it back if you like.

reviewCommentsList.author: bthomee
reviewCommentsList.body: I think this can now be changed to `testMultisig()` and the function body updated to use all features. I don't see any other uses of this test function with different features enabled.

reviewCommentsList.body: Thanks, Bart, fixed

reviewCommentsList.author: vvysokikh1
reviewCommentsList.body: I'm just wondering if it's possible to add some test feature (inside of jtx). I don't want us to mess with tests each time we retire the feature which happens to be used for some unrelated tests.

reviewCommentsList.author: vvysokikh1
reviewCommentsList.body: could be simply env.fund(XRP(250) - drops(1), ...), this variable is not required

reviewCommentsList.author: vvysokikh1
reviewCommentsList.body:
I would suggest to re-enable it to check that reserve requirements don't change regardless of the size of this list. 

I understand that from the code perspective it does not make much sense. But from the perspective of the user, this allows to verify that signer list is only counted as 1 object (thus 1 reserve equivalent), regardless of the size

reviewCommentsList.author: pratikmankawde
reviewCommentsList.body:
Shouldn't we pass `features` to the `env` initialiser list (here and in other similar functions)?

Not passing it might lead to a potential bug. Because caller of this function will assume that the env. in these functions are initialised with the passed in features.

prs.body:
Reduces the account reserve for a multisigning SignerList:

- From (currently) 3 to 10 OwnerCounts, based on the number of signers in the list,
- To 1 OwnerCount, independent of the number of signers in the list.

Includes a transition process.  Implements the changes described in the internal spec.

No hurry on the review.  We probably don't want to merge this until after 1.1.0 is in the bag.
prs.head: scottschurr:multisig-reserve

reviewCommentsList.author: seelabs
reviewCommentsList.body: Calling functions `old...` or `new...` get awkward if we modify this code again. Sometimes during a transition we can name things `old...` and eventually remove the function, but this function needs to stay around forever. For a function like this, I'm OK with a long cumbersome name if you can think of one. Maybe `multiOwnerCountDelta`?

reviewCommentsList.author: seelabs
reviewCommentsList.body: I wish we didn't have to do this, but I don't see another way.

reviewCommentsList.author: MarkusTeufelberger
reviewCommentsList.body: `preMultiSignReserveAmendmentOwnerCountDelta`? ;-)

reviewCommentsList.author: scottschurr
reviewCommentsList.body: Great point about the "old" name.  I struggled with this a bit and then punted.  Maybe `signerCountBasedOwnerCountDelta()`?  That reflects what the function does and what we moved away from.  I'll go with that unless I hear objections or a better suggestion.

reviewCommentsList.author: seelabs
reviewCommentsList.body: Yeah, that works :+1:
